Building a qualified audience

Content Ideation rule of thumb:

Talk about a result, a win, or a problem you've solved for a student or something you talk about in your mentorship.

Use your own experience if you don't have that kind of audience yet.

Titles

my trading setup made me $139,200 last month...
i can pass funded accounts in hours... (full step by step breakdown)
after taking so many losses here's what you can learn from my mistakes.

Example titles

More of this

Tradingkole trades

How to Create your own Profitable Trading Strategy

EcomNathan Miller

If your thinking about doing ecom in 2026 watch this... (brutally honest)

the lesson is already on the screen

Video sequence

keep a few notes and talk it through
01

Intro

Show a payout, a student result or your live dashboard. Tell them what you did and what you'll cover.

02

Body

Give a quick intro, explain what changed for you, then walk through what you did.

03

Mid-video CTA

Once you've taught something useful, mention where they can get your help. Then carry on.

04

Body

Show another example. Explain why you made each decision and where people tend to get stuck.

05

Final CTA

Remind them what this helped you or your students do. Point them to the free training if they want help.

Mid-video CTA could sound like:

that's one of the things we work through in the program. if you want help applying it, the first link below explains more. if not, no worries, keep watching.

Final CTA could sound like:

that's how we got [result]. if you're struggling with [problem], there's a link below designed to sell you something. it starts with a free training on how we do this. if it's not for you, no worries, see you next time.
